facts_raw.Primary Value: Capital + Customer / Pilot Access + PMF / GTM
facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Investment selection; payments linked to one or more performance milestones
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Strategy Track typically SAFE, convertible note or direct investment; Project Track may use SAFE, D-SAFE, convertible note or direct investment, milestone-linked.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: For-profit standalone company, novel business model/technology with deep environmental/local impact; ≥3 full-time employees and an operating prototype. No consulting firms, nonprofits or acquired startups.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 US / global 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: Climate / Energy；阶段以 Growth / deployment 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目；只有想法、无 MVP/traction 的极早期项目
facts_raw.Notes: Elemental no longer operates primarily as an annual cohort accelerator; 2026 model is rolling catalytic investment + project/strategy support.

facts.Primary Value: Capital + Customer / Pilot Access + PMF / GTM
facts.Funding Trigger: Investment selection; payments linked to one or more performance milestones
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Strategy Track typically SAFE, convertible note or direct investment; Project Track may use SAFE, D-SAFE, convertible note or direct investment, milestone-linked.
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: For-profit standalone company, novel business model/technology with deep environmental/local impact; ≥3 full-time employees and an operating prototype. No consulting firms, nonprofits or acquired startups.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No standard attendance requirement published. Confirm the current cohort arrangements for US / global.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Climate / Energy; primarily at the Growth / deployment stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses; Idea-only projects without an MVP or traction
facts.Notes: Elemental no longer operates primarily as an annual cohort accelerator; 2026 model is rolling catalytic investment + project/strategy support.
